verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs clearly document next-day and 2-day direct deposit payroll options (gusto-docs-3, gusto-docs-15) as an alternative to checks, which is the core of this founder story. However, a hands-on account describes Gusto capping 2-day payroll at ~$60k even with ample funds, requiring recurring manual support intervention with bank screenshots, and ultimately switching providers over this friction (gusto-comm-11) — a concrete contradiction of the frictionless fast-deposit promise. Missing for 10: independent confirmation the cap issue is resolved or was an isolated account-specific limit, and more recent hands-on validation of next-day/2-day reliability at scale.
